label: COMPUTED
method: blade as a clamped-clamped plate strip of span b (hub to shroud), Euler-Bernoulli, first mode 22.373/(2 pi) sqrt(E t^2 / (12 rho)) / b^2 (Blevins, Formulas for Natural Frequency and Mode Shape, table 8-1)
assumptions: E=70 GPa, rho=2700 kg/m3 (6082-T6), t=4 mm, b=53.93 mm; ignores centrifugal stiffening (raises f) and root fillets (raise f); disc and shroud nodal-diameter modes not covered
